name: discord-approvals
description: Approval channel on Discord: a bot posts approval requests with buttons and receives presses over the Gateway (no public URL, no privileged intents).

settings.label: Bot token
settings.help: discord.com/developers → your app → Bot → Reset Token. Invite the bot with View Channel and Send Messages.

settings.label: Channel id
settings.help: Type /channel-id in the channel and the bot replies with it (or Developer Mode → right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID). A channel link works too.

settings.label: Who may decide
settings.help: Empty: anyone who can see the channel.
